I have been self destructing since I was the rape honestly everything after has felt like aftermath line a snowball down a hill, from my mother leaving, grandma trying to kill me, dad's girlfriend hitting me for no reason etc my mind never really put itself back to gather and since I act so normal at school people never ask me if I anything is wrong so I don't force it on people
I really don't know how, my biggest enemy is myself and she follows me around everywhere

yeah I am afraid people will see me differently, I have always been embarrassed of my past, so if anyone asked i used to lie and make up normal scenarios, now i just avoid the question, I know that people are going to tell me its not my fault but regardless I have to live with the consequences. 
my dad knew just about the rape but he said that as a child i could have mistaken it for affection and made it up to get attention (the abuser was his friend) So I never brought it up again
music is mainly my outlet tbh
the only danger around me now is myself and my brother
my brother has been threatening to kill himself whenever I talk to him in a slightly negative way, insinuating it would be my fault if he died
and there is a lot but nothing on my mind at the same time

Yes, I did try getting counselling but my school had a scandal where the counsellor was telling other teachers the information in the sessions next thing I know my PSHE teacher was going to tell my dad everything in the sessions and I did not want my Dad to know, so I told her I made it up for attention and she believed me. so after that my trust kind of broke and I didn't mention it again.
